bibl.title: Text-Critical Witnesses and Methodology for Isolating a Distinctive D-Text in Acts.
bibl.seg: Eldon Jay Epp, Text-Critical Witnesses and Methodology for Isolating a Distinctive D-Text in Acts.
bibl.note: 1. Introduction. - 2. The nature of D-Text Primary witnesses: textual mixture and conformation to alternate texts: 2.1. Mixture in New Testament manuscripts; - 2.2. Conformation and assimilation among intersecting and competing manuscripts. - 3. A method for isolating D-Textual readings with a high percentage of cohesion among primary D-Text witnesses: 3.1. Explanation of the tables and witnesses; - 3.2. Overlap and duplication of text-critical entries; - 3.3. Consistently-cited witnesses in the tables. - 4. Conclusion.
